pick.headline: Rabbi Meir Kahane assassinated in New York
pick.summary: On 5 November 1990 Meir Kahane, founder of the Jewish Defense League and the Kach movement, was shot dead in a Manhattan hotel by El Sayyid Nosair.
pick.significance: Kahane was an Israeli extremist figure, and his killing in the United States was later linked to the circle around the 1993 World Trade Center bombing.
pick.fbis: Poorly reproduced in the scan, the Near East & South Asia report of 8 November 1990 carried an unattributed commentary from the Baghdad-based Voice of the PLO under the FBIS heading that the Kahane killing was lauded.
